decisions.decision:
Make every fix in the spec now: edit the card text in app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts and the matching card-education entries, plus any guide or playbook line that repeats the old wording.
1. Copy every label from the walkthrough captures and journeys/<tool>.md. Do not use memory.
2. GA4: use account level everywhere, to match the card.
3. Kie.ai: write $0.03 to $0.08 an image, taken from Kie.ai's public pricing page.
4. Tantra: rewrite start-tantra-mailboxes around the service account plus Accounts, Verify & Add (see the gather-context memory).
5. Fix Wistia, Stripe and GoHighLevel as listed too. If T-260 later replaces them, their cards go anyway, so this work is not wasted.
6. Write in the Backlinko voice, with no dashes.
7. Run check-guides, check-examples, check-walkthroughs and the stack probes.
8. Commit, merge to main through the Integrator flow, deploy the Worker and publish the mirror.
9. Move the task to review and list the changes for each tool.
decisions.why: The spec is complete and comes from the walkthrough agents' reports of 2026-10-08. It is all copy work on our own repo, so no input from Adi is needed. The orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted] rules say to build it fully and send it to Adi only for review.
